title: Tech Graphics: Uniform And Gear Details
request: Oct 18 2026 22:30 ICT: decks for the graphics of the technicians (how techs are illustrated in the investor pitch and brand graphics, not the tech app); drawn SVG mockups only; fixed picks from the earlier uniform decks drawn in, not re-asked
note: Oct 18 2026 22:30 ICT request: uniform and gear details in tech graphics (back wordmark view, name, belt gear, tablet, cover inset, cap, sleeves, callouts, softshell layer, van)
fixed_picks: Drawn in, not asked: illustrated people only; healthy, fit young adults with varied builds; left-chest logo, big back wordmark, printed first name, white cap with front mark, long charcoal pants, plain black belt, sneakers for good weather and boots for bad weather, terracotta reusable logo shoe covers always visible, charcoal softshell for cold days.
example_data: Every card is a hand-built SVG mockup of an illustrated tech (round-2 pitch figure style); sample first name only; nothing live is changed.
built_at_note: Tech graphics decks Oct 18 2026 22:30 ICT request

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Back wordmark view, should brand graphics show the tech from the front only or as a front-and-back pair that shows the big back wordmark?

optionA.label: Front View Only
optionA.desc: One front view with the left-chest logo.

optionB.label: Front And Back
optionB.desc: Front view plus a back view with the full wordmark.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Printed first name, should graphics show the printed first name under the chest logo or leave the name off at graphic size?

optionA.label: Name Under Logo
optionA.desc: A sample first name printed under the left-chest logo.

optionB.label: Logo Only
optionB.desc: Left-chest logo with no name drawn.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Belt gear, should techs be drawn with a full tool belt with two pouches or one slim utility pouch on the hip?

optionA.label: Tool Belt
optionA.desc: Two canvas pouches with tools, tape and terracotta stitching.

optionB.label: Utility Pouch
optionB.desc: One slim flap pouch with a terracotta tab.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Tablet, should the tech hold the work tablet in hand with a checklist on screen or carry it in a holster on the belt?

optionA.label: Tablet In Hand
optionA.desc: Held at the hip, checklist screen facing out.

optionB.label: Tablet On The Belt
optionB.desc: Tucked in a holster on the hip, hands free.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Shoe cover display, should the terracotta logo shoe covers be drawn on the feet only or on the feet plus a close-up inset?

optionA.label: Drawn On The Feet
optionA.desc: Covers with the logo on both feet, nothing extra.

optionB.label: On The Feet Plus Inset
optionB.desc: Same covers on the feet plus a close-up badge with the logo.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: White cap, should techs be drawn wearing the white cap with the terracotta house mark or bare-headed?

optionA.label: White Cap
optionA.desc: White cap, terracotta house mark on the front.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Polo sleeves, should polo sleeves be drawn rolled once at the cuff or straight with the stitched band?

optionA.label: Rolled Sleeves
optionA.desc: A single neat roll at the sleeve end.

optionB.label: Straight Sleeves
optionB.desc: Plain sleeve with a stitched rib band.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Gear callout labels, should a tech graphic name the gear with small callout labels or show the tech with no labels?

optionA.label: Callout Labels
optionA.desc: Thin leader lines to cap, logo, tablet, belt and covers.

optionB.label: No Labels
optionB.desc: The same tech and gear, no text on the art.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Seasonal layering, should brand graphics include a charcoal softshell over the polo for cold days or show the polo only?

optionA.label: Softshell Over Polo
optionA.desc: Cold-day tech in the softshell and boots beside a polo tech.

optionB.label: Polo Only
optionB.desc: Both techs in polos; footwear still shows the weather.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Tech Graphics: Van in the background, should the tech stand in front of the branded van or alone on cream?

optionA.label: With The Van
optionA.desc: Tech in front with the white van and wordmark behind.

optionB.label: Tech Alone
optionB.desc: Just the tech on warm cream.
